generator_cmd: python3 -I gen2.py firefox_style.har  (json.dump writer: Firefox-style HAR, 2 pages, 5 entries, mixed +01:00/Z startedDateTime out of stored order, bodySize -1, IPv6/empty serverIPAddress, userinfo+port URL, one string status "200")
oracle_cmd: jq -r ".log.entries[]|[.startedDateTime,.request.url]|@tsv" $H | while IFS=$(printf "\t") read t u; do echo "$(date -u -d "$t" +%s.%N) $u"; done | LC_ALL=C sort -s -n -k1,1 | head -1 | cut -d" " -f2
